test_title: PYST 66: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Kiara starts from Point A, which is 5 km towards the north of Z. From Point A, she turns towards the east and drives 8 km. She then takes a right turn and drives 9 km. Finally, she takes a right turn, drives for 15 km and stops at Point B. In which direction is Point B with respect to Point Z?
solution:
Given:

Kiara starts from Point A, which is 5 km towards the north of Z.

From Point A, she turns towards the east and drives 8 km.

She then takes a right turn and drives 9 km.

Finally, she takes a right turn, drives for 15 km and stops at Point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3001735c7f910878b907ed76c5a83c962ad83687da4b4bf2f954bd0bd4fc20c.png] 

Thus, Point B is to the southwest of Point Z.

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
